Table 5.43: SwCalibrationAccessEnum [TPS_SWCT_1273] Precedence rules for the application of SwDataDefProps⌈ SwDataDefProps can be speciﬁed on various levels, from type over prototype to in- stantiation, ﬁnally data access and calibration support after RTE generation. In general, properties speciﬁed on prototype level override the ones speciﬁed on type level.
